palette: 宣纸米 field + 青砖灰绿 wall + 朱砂禁红 + 暮金 + 石青
typography: heavy ink-black headings, chalk label blocks on brick, vermilion seal stamps
composition: a horizontal fortress wall anchors each scene: crossbow range lanes beneath it, twin gates and garrison pillars on it, frontier route boards radiating beside it
surface: brick coursing, paper plaques with ink borders, dashed gold exception threads, vermilion seal stamps; no glossy panels
motion: staged reveals in legal-reasoning order, seals land as verdicts, dashed connectors traverse the wall line; no idle loops
transition: the wall line persists as the carrier while each scene re-stages the same fortress plane
